Name: Wizard of Waterdeep -  Gale Dekarios Replacement Portrait and Sprites
Author: wellbornfawn
Description:
Hello all! :)

This is a simple mod for aesthetics only.
It is also my first mod so any feedback would be greatly appreciated!

This is a portrait and sprite replacement for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21855?tab=description]Wizard of Waterdeep[/url]﻿, Gale Dekarios!
As such, you will need to download that mod and all its prerequisites for this one to work.


[u][size=3]1.1 is here with a shorter Gale, new teleport (for first meeting) and sleeping sprites, and new winter portraits + sprites![/size][/u]

[size=3][u]1.2 is here with a much-needed portraits overhaul AND his iconic purple robe as new portraits + sprites![/u]
[/size]
[b]Installation:[/b]
1. Unzip the folder
2. Replace pngs in original Wizard of Waterdeep mod with the pngs included
3. Follow the 1.1 Seasonal Sprites Guide in Articles so that all sprites appear
4. Smooch that wizard! :)


[b]Credits:
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/179164935]peachygeo[/url] for the wonderful base mod and for letting me post this!

I will check comments semi-regularly so if you run into any issues leave a comment and I will see what I can do ASAP! :)
Thanks for stopping by!
